character.name: Luken Voss
traits: Polite to a fault, never raises his voice even when committing murder
Methodical planner, adheres strictly to his 13-victim ritual pattern
Hides a collection of tiny trophies from each kill in a false satchel bottom, known to no one
Can dismember a body as quickly and cleanly as he butchered livestock as an apprentice
character.gear: Whet-worn steel butcher's knife · Dark-dyed leather assassin's garb · 3 strips of spiced cured meat · Small glass vial of nightshade tincture · Thin silk garrote · Hand-drawn district alley map · Iron ring with 12 carved notches
character.story: Luken Voss served as a quiet butcher's apprentice for years, mastering swift, precise cuts to break down carcasses. The night he found a drunkard bleeding in the alley behind the shop, he felt the same calm he did at the slaughter block. He buried the body under the offal heap, and the town blamed a wandering beast. Now he stalks his 13th victim—a helpful neighbour the guard are hunting—his polite smile never slipping as he carves the final notch into his hidden iron ring.

inventory.name: Whet-worn butcher's knife
inventory.lore: Given to him by his master butcher, modified to have an edge sharp enough to slip between ribs without tearing flesh, used for both carcasses and victims.
inventory.description: A standard steel butcher's knife, worn smooth from years of use, still faintly smells of tallow.

inventory.name: Dark-dyed leather assassin's garb
inventory.lore: Stitched with extra padding to muffle movement, dyed black to blend into shadows, still carries the faint scent of the butcher shop's tallow.
inventory.description: Fitted leather armor, designed for silent movement and protection without restricting stealth.

inventory.name: Spiced cured meat strips
inventory.lore: Cured by his master butcher with cloves and salt, a reminder of his old life, saved for when the ritual pattern feels unstable.
inventory.description: Three strips of tough, salty cured meat, enough to stave off hunger for a day.

inventory.name: Nightshade paralysis tincture
inventory.lore: Stolen from the town apothecary as an apprentice, causes swift paralysis without pain, used on 7 of his 12 victims to date.
inventory.description: A small glass vial of thick, dark purple liquid, sealed with wax.
inventory.effects: Applied to a blade, the target must make a DC 13 CON save or be paralyzed for 1 minute, no pain felt.

inventory.name: Silk garrote
inventory.lore: Woven from the butcher's silk wrapping cloth, strong enough to snap a neck in seconds, leaves no bruising or marks on the skin.
inventory.description: A thin, flexible length of tightly woven silk, strong enough to throttle a grown man in seconds.

inventory.name: Hand-drawn district alley map
inventory.lore: Drawn over months of stalking, marks guard patrol routes, dark alleyways, and the spots where he leaves small ritual offerings to mark each kill.
inventory.description: A crumpled parchment map, marked with tiny symbols and notes in neat, unassuming handwriting.

inventory.name: Iron ritual notched ring
inventory.lore: Found in the butcher's scrap metal pile, he has carved one notch for each of his 12 victims, the 13th is half-carved, waiting for the final offering.
inventory.description: A simple iron ring, worn smooth, with 12 small notches carved into its inner edge.
